passkeyBrowserBody: Chrome offers existing profiles first and remembers your selection. A temporary profile is used only when none matches. Firefox uses an isolated profile. Imported sign-in is verified.
webSubagentsBody: Allow ChatGPT Web tasks to delegate to Codex agents and use JavaScript tool orchestration. When off, commands and individual tool calls still work. Native-model tasks are unaffected. New installations start with this off; existing settings are preserved.
compactionModelBody: Choose the model used only for the next automatic Pro context summary. Task turns keep their original model. Unavailable choices fail before sending; no fallback is selected.
routingCatalogFailureBody: Codex reached NEKODEX, but the model catalog request failed. Check Activity and the routing details above; export privacy-safe diagnostics if the failure persists.
usageBody: Counts accepted browser messages, including context staging, from installation of this feature. Manual sends have unknown model identity. Unknown versions are never guessed. Unrecorded outcomes include active requests and interrupted recording. Local days; not official quotas or remaining allowances.
usageNativeBody: Counts requests observed through the native proxy. This is separate from Web browser-message usage and does not represent all native activity outside NEKODEX.
usageNativeAccountUnavailable: Browser-account filtering is unavailable because native token accounts are not linked to browser accounts.
usageNativeEmpty: No native proxied requests in this period.
usageNativeDurationSamples: Accept-to-outcome duration for {count} observed native requests.
usageNativeNoDurations: No reliable accept-to-outcome native-request samples in this period.
usageNativeCalendarSummary: {total} native proxied requests across {active} of {days} days.
usageTokenUsageBody: Only provider-reported token fields are summed. Missing reports remain unknown.
usageLifetimeGroups: Lifetime messages by mode and model
usageLifetimeUnclassified: Older accepted messages without retained model details
usageRecovered: Usage history was restored from a local backup. Recent messages or outcomes may be missing.
usageBackupUnavailable: The recovery backup could not be updated. Current usage is still saved in the main history file.
usageStaleBody: The latest refresh failed. These figures still match the selected account and period.
usageEmpty: No accepted messages in this period.
usageEmptyHelp: Try another source or reporting period.
usageNativeKnownRateBody: {completed} completed / {known} completed + failed + cancelled + incomplete outcomes.
usageNoKnownOutcomes: No completed, failed, cancelled or incomplete outcomes yet.
usageUnrecordedExcluded: {count} unrecorded outcomes are excluded from this rate.
usageNoDurations: No reliable accept-to-outcome message samples in this period.
usageNoFailures: No classified failures in this period.
accountProxyBody: Applies to this account’s browser only. Save while idle; existing connections are recycled and the account must be checked again. URLs with embedded credentials are not accepted.
pacingBody: Pacing applies to new turns. Rate-limit cooldowns always apply and never switch a task to another account. These controls do not guarantee account safety.
pacingStopped: Account paused. Review the ChatGPT account before resuming.
newSessionWindowBody: Optional local safety budget for creating new automatic ChatGPT Web browser sessions on this account. It works independently of ordinary pacing. Existing, running, and retained Web sessions can continue when the window is full; other cooldowns and pacing protections still apply. It never switches a task to another account and is not a provider quota.
newSessionWindowUsage: Current window: {used} of {limit} used in {minutes} minutes · {remaining} remaining
newSessionWindowNoSessions: No new sessions counted in the current window.
freshConversationBody: Send the complete task context in a new chat each turn. Uses more input and avoids retained-chat reuse. Local tools remain attached.
savedChatsBody: When enabled, chats are stored in ChatGPT history. ChatGPT may apply your saved memory and custom instructions.
asyncToolOperationsBody: For tools that may run longer than 90 seconds. Create and verify the separate {connector} connector before use. New Full setups enable this mode by default; existing connector identities are preserved. Cancelling after dispatch stops observation only; an external action may continue.
asyncToolOperationsUnavailable: Available only after Automatic Full setup and while launcher work is idle. Model and workspace routes are unaffected.
manualSubmitTimeBody: Time to paste the prompt and upload attachments before confirming Sent. Changes apply to new turns.
skillAttachmentsBody: Upload explicitly selected Codex skills as named text files instead of inline instructions. Other skills still load through tools. Off by default; uses the same attachment limit as images.
manualSkillAttachmentsUnavailable: Skill uploads require automatic browser interaction.
setupConfirmBody: The installation is saved and Codex has loaded the catalog. Open its model picker and confirm that the NEKODEX models are visible. Reinstalling is not needed.
setupCatalogTitle: Waiting for Codex to load the models
setupCatalogBody: The settings are saved, but a successful catalog request has not been observed yet. Open the Codex model picker and check the routing below. If models are still missing, restart Codex after finishing your work.
setupOptionalCheck: The models are already installed. Use this optional check if you need to verify a fresh reply.
overviewSubtitle: Your accounts, agents and tools. Together.
artCardBody: Multiple accounts. Smarter agents. A more open way to build.
overviewTitle: A little setup. A lot of possibility.
overviewBody: Connect ChatGPT to get your workspace ready.
overviewReadyBody: Open ChatGPT or continue a task in Codex. NEKODEX keeps your accounts and local tools connected.
capacityHint: Active setting; actual simultaneous capacity is not verified.
runningHint: Tasks running across your open account profiles.
overviewActiveRunsBody: Observed tabs that are running, loading or testing.
quickToolsBody: Give your agents access to files and commands.
activityEmptyBody: Your task activity will appear here.
settingsSubtitle: Shape how NEKODEX works for you.
welcomeReadyBody: NEKODEX brings your ChatGPT accounts, coding agents, and tools into one place. Start with your account; connect the rest when you need it.
welcomeAccountsBody: Sign in with separate, saved browser profiles.
welcomeToolsBody: Connect Codex to your files and commands.
welcomePrivacyBody: Choose your models, routing, and task capacity.
accountsManual: Manual mode uses the selected account. Sign in inside its browser; automated account and connector inspection stays disabled.
accountsBody: Each account has its own saved login. Sign in, then check each account before balanced routing. For tool tasks, also check its connector. Continuing tasks stay with their original account.
accountsRefreshFailed: Account status could not be refreshed. The last successful view may be out of date. Retry before changing accounts.
browserCapacityBody: Configurable browser task limit: 1–1000. This ceiling is not a verified simultaneous-session capacity and does not increase your ChatGPT allowance.
capacityInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
browserCapacityRestart: Saved. Finish active tasks, then quit and reopen NEKODEX to apply. Closing the window alone may keep the app running.
contextBudgetEvidence: These built-in bridge budgets come from the transport profile. They are not a fresh capacity measurement of the selected ChatGPT model or its API window.
confirmPicker: I can see the Web models in Codex
contextActiveStandard: Active: standard history budget. This is a browser-transfer budget, not the API model context window.
contextActiveBigger: Active: Bigger Context, 3× the standard history budget. Larger turns use up to six messages; the API model window is unchanged.
contextWaiting: Change saved. Waiting for active requests to finish; the current budget remains active.
contextFailed: The context change could not be applied. The current setting was kept.
hermesTitle: Use NEKODEX in Hermes through Codex
hermesDirectBody: Keeps the Hermes tool loop, but live tool calls may be blocked by ChatGPT. Adding this provider preserves your selected model.
hermesBody: Selects Web High for new Hermes sessions, with files, commands and edits handled by Codex. Existing providers and settings are backed up. Applies a checked Hermes compatibility patch so the selected Web model is used. Hermes memory, delegation, session search and todo tools are unavailable in this runtime.
hermesPending: Finish the ChatGPT tool connector above to enable live Hermes tool calls.
hermesChoose: After setup, restart Hermes and start a new session using NEKODEX via Codex · FroRaut.
hermesAdded: Connection saved. Restart Hermes and use a new session. The Codex runtime choice selects Web High; adding the experimental provider keeps your current selection.
setupOverviewTitle: One setup, then work in Codex
setupPendingConnector: Tunnel connected · finish the ChatGPT connector
setupArchitecture: Choose a NEKODEX model in Codex. This app keeps the ChatGPT session and connection running. For files and commands, connect Codex tools once in ChatGPT.
setupUseCodex: Keep this app open and select NEKODEX in Codex. Connector verification confirms availability; a real task confirms tool execution.
setupToolsNext: Continue with Codex tools below to enable file reads, commands and edits. Models-only operation does not provide those tools.
existingChromeVerificationFailed: Chrome connected, but ChatGPT did not accept the imported session. Open sign in here to complete verification, or bring the intended signed-in Chrome profile forward and retry.
devSetupTitle: Set up the isolated DEV profile
devSetupSubtitle: This browser, account, configuration, and runtime data stay separate from the normal launcher and Codex.
devStepInstallBody: Store account capabilities in the isolated DEV home. No Codex route, Responses listener, or system service is installed; Full mode supervises only its isolated MCP tunnel.
devMcpSubtitle: Connect this separate ChatGPT account to the isolated repository harness.
devMcpBody: The DEV launcher keeps its isolated MCP tunnel ready. Named repository chats attach to it and return explicit simulated receipts for tool actions.
devConnectorIsolationNotice: Create a separate connector with the exact Codex Native4 DEV name below. Keep Codex Native3 DEV as a legacy connector; the new DEV and normal connectors can run side by side.
devKeepRunningBody: Keep the isolated browser session and DEV MCP tunnel available when this window closes.
biggerContextBody: Warning: keeps small turns as one message, then splits large context across two or six messages. The final part starts the task without an extra request. It triples the bridge history budget and compaction thresholds. Changes wait for active requests to finish. Try a new Codex task afterward; restart only if it still uses the old settings. Extra requests may increase rate limits or temporary cooldowns. Disabled by default.
biggerContextRecommendationBody: Bigger Context sends large tasks in multiple messages so NEKODEX can use up to three times more context. It remains experimental and can increase rate limits or temporary cooldowns.
biggerContextRecommendationToggleBody: Stage large tasks across multiple messages and raise the model context and compaction limits.
tagline: NEKODEX inside the native Codex harness
chooseLanguageHint: You can change this later in Settings.
supportBody: Visit FroRaut's repository on GitHub. This is optional; choose Open launcher whenever you are ready.
browserCancelTaskBody: This cancels the turn in this tab. Work already performed is not undone.
browserTabLimit: Up to 16 simultaneous NEKODEX tabs across Codex tasks. ChatGPT account limits still apply.
noActiveTaskBody: ChatGPT will appear here when Codex starts a Web model turn.
setupSubtitle: Connect your account, test one reply, install the models, then connect tools if needed.
interactionModeOnboardingBody: Choose how the launcher should work with ChatGPT. With Automation is selected by default. You can change this later in Settings.
automaticInteractionBody: Automatically sends prompts and reads ChatGPT page state. Controlled retries avoid repeated sends, but browser automation may conflict with OpenAI terms or account policies.
manualInteractionBody: Never reads or changes ChatGPT. The launcher prepares the prompt; you paste it, choose the connector, model, and effort, and send it yourself.
stepAccountBody: Sign in directly in the embedded ChatGPT browser. Login stays in this launcher's private profile.
existingChromeBody: Use the ChatGPT account already signed in to your current Google Chrome profile. No fresh profile is created.
existingChromePreparingBody: Waiting for the previous sign-in check to stop before requesting Chrome permission. You can cancel this wait; Chrome has not been connected.
existingChromeHandoffRemaining: Time remaining for the previous check: {time}
existingChromeHandoffTimeout: The previous launcher sign-in check is still stopping. Retry after it finishes, or restart NEKODEX. No Chrome session was imported.
existingChromeAccessDenied: The operating system blocked access to Chrome’s connection information. Check access permissions for NEKODEX, then retry.
existingChromeAllowFile: Allow access to Chrome connection file
existingChromeFileSelection: Choose the Chrome connection file in the macOS dialog
existingChromeFileBody: Select only DevToolsActivePort in the Google Chrome folder shown by the dialog. The launcher reads this one file immediately; Chrome then asks separately whether to allow the connection.
existingChromeWrongFile: Choose only the DevToolsActivePort file in the Google Chrome folder shown by the dialog. Other files, folders and links are not accepted.
existingChromeMissingConnection: Chrome’s approved remote-debugging connection is unavailable. Open Google Chrome, enable remote debugging at the address below, and retry.
existingChromeInvalidConnection: Chrome’s connection information is invalid. Reopen its remote-debugging settings and retry.
existingChromeDenied: Chrome did not allow the connection. Retry and choose Allow in Chrome’s own permission dialog.
existingChromeOldVersion: Importing the current profile requires Google Chrome 144 or later with native connection approval. Update Chrome, then retry.
existingChromeDisconnected: Chrome disconnected before the import finished. Keep your signed-in Chrome profile open and retry.
existingChromeInvalidResponse: Chrome returned an unsupported or oversized response. No sign-in was imported.
existingChromeNoSession: Your current Chrome profile has no usable ChatGPT sign-in. Open ChatGPT in the correct Chrome profile, then retry.
existingChromeCaptureFailed: The private sign-in capture could not be saved. Check that the launcher can write its application data, then retry.
existingChromeAuthorizationFailed: The launcher could not authorize its private import helper. Restart NEKODEX and retry.
existingChromeVerify: Chrome disconnected; verifying the imported sign-in…
existingChromeSteps: In Google Chrome 144 or later, open the address below, enable remote debugging, and approve Chrome’s Allow connection dialog. The launcher uses this connection once to read ChatGPT/OpenAI sign-in cookies. Keep your signed-in Chrome profile open.
existingChromeFailure: The existing Chrome sign-in could not be imported. Check that ChatGPT is signed in to your current Chrome profile, remote debugging is enabled, and Chrome’s connection dialog was approved. Then retry.
existingChromeCleanupFailed: Import cleanup could not finish. Temporary sign-in data or a partial launcher session may remain. Retry the import before using the launcher session.
existingChromeTimeout: Chrome permission timed out. Check the settings and try again.
existingChromeCancelled: Chrome import cancelled. Your Chrome stays open.
existingChromeDone: Your Chrome sign-in was imported and verified. You can turn off remote debugging in Chrome now.
existingChromeDuringImport: The launcher checks the imported session in its own browser. Your normal Chrome stays open.
passkeyRevealFailed: browser could not be brought forward. Use Mission Control to find the dedicated login window, or cancel and retry.
passkeyRecoveryBody: Retry lets you choose an existing Chrome profile or a new isolated sign-in.
passkeyWindowTitle: Complete sign-in in the separate browser window
passkeyContinueBody: Use your passkey in the browser window opened by this launcher. Wait until the ChatGPT chat screen appears, then return here and choose Import browser sign-in. Use Mission Control if the window is behind this app.
passkeyImportingBody: NEKODEX is importing and verifying your ChatGPT session. Please wait.
embeddedLoginBody: Finish sign-in using the controls on this page. Browser navigation is paused until sign-in finishes.
embeddedLoginPasskeyBody: Finish sign-in on this page. If Touch ID or your passkey does not appear, choose Use passkey above to switch to a separate browser window.
browserNavigationBusy: The browser is busy. Finish the current operation before navigating or reloading.
stepSmokeBody: Select High, send a small temporary message, and verify a complete streamed response.
stepInstallWaiting: Installed; waiting for Codex to request models
stepInstallWaitingBody: Installation finished. Keep this launcher open and restart Codex. After the catalog is received, confirm that the Web models are visible in Codex. Use the routing check below if it keeps waiting.
stepInstallBody: Add the NEKODEX models without replacing Codex's native catalog. Any current custom route is saved and restored when the bridge is turned off.
zeroRiskModelSettingsBody: Choose which model rows are installed into Codex.
zeroRiskProProfileBody: Also install NEKODEX — Manual mode Pro.
zeroRiskProProfileInfo: Provides roughly 250,000 usable tokens before compaction. Select ChatGPT Pro manually for every turn. A ChatGPT Pro account is required; without it the turn will likely fail, and the larger limit may not work with every effort. Manual mode cannot verify your subscription or selection.
restartCodex: Check the model picker or try a new Codex task. Restart Codex after finishing your work only if the new models or settings are still missing.
codexIntegrationRemovedBody: The previous route has been restored. Try a new Codex task. If it still uses NEKODEX, restart Codex after finishing your work.
codexManualRefreshBody: Manual model profiles have been saved. Open the Codex model picker to check them. If the new profiles are missing, restart Codex after finishing your work.
contextClientRefreshBody: After NEKODEX applies the change, try a new Codex task. Existing tasks may retain earlier limits. Restart Codex only if new tasks still show the old settings.
mcpSubtitle: One-time setup so NEKODEX can use the files and commands of your active Codex task.
mcpBody: Required for file reads, commands and edits; optional if you only want model responses.
mcpStepOne: Create a tunnel and API key
mcpStepOneBody: In OpenAI Platform, create a tunnel for the same account and ChatGPT workspace you use here. Create a Restricted API key with only Tunnels Read + Use. This key runs the tunnel; it is not a model API key. Continue to enter both values locally.
mcpStepTwoBody: Paste the Tunnel ID and API key. The tunnel must belong to the same OpenAI account that will use the ChatGPT plugin. The key stays in private local storage and is never written to launcher logs.
mcpStepTwoHint: You can add the MCP connector in ChatGPT only after this step succeeds and the tunnel is running.
mcpCatalogRequired: First finish the model connection and wait for Codex to load its catalog. Open the model picker or check the routing; restart Codex only if the models are still missing.
credentialsConfiguredBody: The launcher will reuse the private Tunnel ID and API key already stored on this device.
mcpStepThreeStepOne: In ChatGPT Settings, open the exact control “Security and login” and enable “Developer mode”.
mcpStepThreeStepTwo: Open “Plugins” → “Create app” (+), choose “Tunnel” and the running tunnel, set “Authentication” to “None”, and enter the exact connector name below.
mcpStepThreeStepThree: Review the discovered tools and whether each permission applies to this connector or all plugins. Return here and verify the connection.
mcpStepThreePermissions: Commands and edits still require ChatGPT permission and remain subject to Codex sandboxing and approvals.
manualMcpStepThreeBody: Create the separate connector shown below with the exact name Codex Zero Risk4 and select it yourself in every Manual mode turn. Manual mode requires its own tunnel and credentials, separate from Automatic mode. The launcher never inspects the ChatGPT DOM in this mode.
connectorMigrationNotice: Migrating from Codex Native3? Keep that connector as legacy and create Codex Native4 separately; do not rename or refresh the old connector. The codex_exec schema change needs a new connector identity. Codex Native, Native2, and Native3 remain legacy names. Manual mode uses a separate Codex Zero Risk4 connector; Codex Zero Risk and Zero Risk2 remain legacy. Create and verify the new connector before using it for tool tasks.
manualConnectorNotice: Create Codex Zero Risk4 as a separate connector; keep Codex Zero Risk2 as legacy. Select Zero Risk4 yourself before sending every Manual mode prompt; the launcher intentionally does not inspect ChatGPT to verify that choice.
doctorTunnelKeyStored: Tunnel runtime key is stored privately
doctorTunnelRuntimeReady: Tunnel runtime reports healthy and ready
activitySubtitle: Local diagnostics. Export a privacy-safe copy before sharing; raw logs stay on this device.
proModelVersionBody: Takes effect on the next Pro turn and only affects automated Pro routing. If ChatGPT does not offer the exact version, the turn fails without silently falling back.
launchAtLoginBody: Keep the local Responses route available before Codex opens.
keepRunningOnClose: Keep server running when window closes
keepRunningOnCloseBody: Keep ChatGPT Web available by hiding the window in the tray, or minimizing it when no tray is available. Quitting the interface keeps native Codex running; use Stop connections and quit to stop the service.
showDuringTurnsBody: Reveal the embedded ChatGPT surface whenever a browser turn is active.
manualBiggerContextUnavailable: Manual mode already uses a fixed 3× compaction interval. Its prompts remain single-part and manual.
manualPromptInstruction: The prompt is already in your clipboard. Paste it into the open ChatGPT tab, choose the model and effort you want, select the Codex Zero Risk4 connector, send it, then confirm below.
manualPromptWaiting: Waiting for Codex Zero Risk4 to connect
manualPromptRunning: ChatGPT is working through the Codex harness
cancelTurnsBody: Abort the active HTTP stream and its retained ChatGPT browser turn.
uninstallIntegrationBody: Restore the previous Codex model route and remove the private bridge runtime.
localToolsUnavailableBody: The tools tunnel is not ready. Open the connection settings to check its status.
localToolsUnavailableNativeBody: The tools tunnel is not ready. Native Codex remains available. Open the connection settings to check the tunnel.
newConnectorRequired: Create a new App ID. Do not rename the old connector.
connectorAvailableNotExecuted: Connector and local tools are available. A real tool task has not been tested yet.
realToolTaskNotTested: Real tool task not tested yet
manualSetupReadyBody: The local harness and connector are available. For every turn, choose the account, connector, model, and effort, paste the prompt, and send it yourself. A real task confirms tool execution.
catalogFailureKeptInstall: Codex reached NEKODEX, but the model catalog request failed. The installed connection was kept.
usageNativeRecordedOnly: Recorded requests only. Best-effort delivery can miss events, so these totals are not complete coverage.
accountsBusyTasks: Finish {count} active tasks before changing this account.
accountProxyInvalid: Enter a valid URL for the selected proxy mode. Credentials and fragments are not allowed.
accountProxyPacInvalid: Use an HTTPS URL for the PAC file.
accountProxySocksPort: Include a port in the SOCKS5 URL.
accountFormFailed: Could not save these settings. Check the error details and try again.
accountSafetyInvalid: Use whole numbers within the displayed ranges.
launcherRuntimeRestartBody: The updated app is using the previous working runtime. Restart NEKODEX when your tasks are finished to activate the new runtime.
logOutConfirmBody: Log out of ChatGPT in NEKODEX? You will need to sign in again, possibly with a passkey, before new Web turns can run.
